scope: Exploratory grouped cross-validation using only R16 train301 questions /278 event groups; original validation and test labels/features are not used
calibration: one next outer fold as calibration, remaining3 as fit; group assignments frozen first
slot_padding: repeat final real token to width4; append4 presence-mask bits; permutation moves values and mask together
slot_permutation: fixed per-window hash-derived permutation independent of features and labels

mlp.output: arithmetic mean of3 fixed-seed probabilities; no best-seed selection
mlp.optimizer: Adam with coupled weight_decay=1/(C*target_loss_mass), including biases; normalized weighted BCE

hidden_projection.source: mean hidden_28 after final RMSNorm across same raw BPE4 window
hidden_projection.method: fit-only weighted centered randomized SVD, unwhitened; no label-based component selection
hidden_projection.seed_rule: base seed plus zero-based fold index

thresholds: calibration-only maxF1 with existing higher-precision then higher-threshold tie rule; separate window and whole-answer max thresholds
eligibility: same frozen R16 labels; refusals have answer gold0 but are excluded from localization; unresolved excluded
geometry: all output-derived windows regardless of gold; answer scores max over all candidates including refusals
report: all configurations, group-held-out pooled confusion/F1, foldwise AUROC/AP, conditional within-risk-answer peaks, risk-span coverage and highlight burden; individual MLP seeds descriptive only
limits: higher-dimensional slots and hidden branch have different capacity
same numeric regularization does not equate LR and MLP capacity
negative result does not prove information-theoretic insufficiency
alignment16 uses earlier R10 weak semantic heuristics, not an entailment model
train-source CV is exploratory after earlier diagnostics, not a fresh confirmatory test
